## Problem

What cannot be named well today? Give a concrete (fictional) example.

## Proposal

The rule, code, or form you want, as it would appear in the standard.

## Affected sections

Files and sections, e.g. `01-naming-conventions.md`, "4.3 Capability codes".

## Breaking?

- [ ] Additive (no valid name becomes invalid)
- [ ] Breaking (list names that change)
